notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own spawn room and end trigger (gb-maps-1). A race surf map: eleven sections, each section's pits aimed at its own Nspawn, entered from the spawn room through the teleport to 1enter. The finish is the map's own trigger_once `endtrigger`, which the importer reads as a finish by its name; in the source game it ends the round by enabling a `youlose` teleport to the jail over every section, and a logic_timer later enables the `timesup` ones. Those start disabled and are dropped here (round_teleports), with the jail's own internal teleports: this game runs no rounds, and imported as pits they sent every runner to jail on entering a section. The button-enabled `hiddenteleport` in the secret room is kept as the pit it imports as. Not published.
